chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, from a man, from Jamil ibn Dirraj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Hasten your youth with the hadith (prophetic traditions/knowledge) before the Murji'ah overtake you to them."

key_terms.الْمُرْجِئَةُ: The Murji'ah (a theological sect known for ta'wil/delaying judgment on sins)

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam mean by hastening youth with hadith before the Murji'ah?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) urges the youth to proactively acquire religious knowledge before the Murji'ah, a prominent early theological school that emphasized faith over deeds, can dominate the intellectual landscape. This advice highlights the Shia emphasis on early, active engagement with authentic traditions to preserve doctrinal purity against competing Sunni theological interpretations.
